item.title: The 3 Canon Compact Cameras Made Digital Photos Feel Like Film
item.description: Canon cameras are now only working with CMOS sensors, which, while fast, leave one wanting more. The latter is the case for photographers who want analog-like inages but without investing in a film camera. If you share this perspective, then consider the following three Canon compact cameras, which feature CCD sensors that deliver rich colors and fine grain. Without further ado, let's dig in.

item.title: What Happened to Chase Jarvis?
item.description: Chase Jarvis is a name that has been quite prominent in the photography circles. A photographer, director, author, and entrepreneur, Chase has helped millions of people pick up a camera and make a living from it. However, in the past year, the company's YouTube Channel has stopped uploading conversations with other photographers, while the blog is floating with articles about AI image generation tools. So, what exactly happened, and where is he now?

item.title: The Best Mirrorless Cameras Under $1000 for Young Creators
item.description: Mirrorless cameras are now taking center stage worldwide. Many young photographers who want to afford a good camera often find themselves lacking good options that are also reasonably priced. If you are someone who also feels stuck, then here are some options in the small sensor range that can be of help. These models, with the right lens, can be the powerhouse that helps with different genres of shooting scenarios.

item.title: The Soul Missing in Modern Street Photography
item.description: There was a time that I truly thought that all street photography should be done in black and white. I also thought that film was the best format for it -- partially because of the grain, how ti rendered the scenes, and how classic everything looked. But my mind has changed since then at least in some ways. However, I think that there's something critically missing from much of street photography today: grit. Instead, it's all about pleasing an algorithm.
